My role

I provide clerical, notarial, and translation support so you arrive organized and prepared when working with government agencies.

My boundaries

I do not provide legal advice, immigration assistance, form selection, or representation before any agency. You choose your forms; I type what you provide.

DMV Document Preparation

Clerical only. You tell me the exact form(s) and give me the information; I type it exactly as provided, you review and approve it, and you submit it. DMV forms are free from the government; my fee covers only typing and my time.

DMV Proxy Packages

Can't go to the DMV yourself? I submit your documents in person as your authorized proxy.

One notarized form, two ways to get it done

Option A · I act for you

Sign the DR 2175 Power of Attorney naming me, and once it is notarized I can handle your DMV submission on your behalf.

Option B · Someone you trust acts for you

Need a family member or friend to handle the DMV for you, or are you acting for someone else? I can notarize the DR 2175 so the person named can act on the owner's behalf.

Notarization: $15 per signature, or $10 at a Community Hub. The owner chooses who to name on the form; I do not advise on that choice. The DR 2175 expires on the date printed on the form.

Colorado Bonded Title Document Prep

For clients who have already decided to apply for a Colorado bonded title and want the paperwork typed, organized, and mailing-ready. Available remotely anywhere in Colorado.

New

Bonded title package

Bonded title document prep

$150 flat document prep

Purely administrative preparation. You supply the vehicle and ownership information; I format it.

Questions about the process? See the bonded title FAQ.

  • Administrative preparation of Form DR 2489A (vehicle record request)
  • Administrative preparation of Form DR 2394 (Bond Statement Guide & In Lieu of Bond Affidavit)
  • Organizing your DR 2704 certified VIN inspection paperwork
  • Formatting the certified mailings to prior owners of record
  • Bilingual checklist of every document you provide

Paid separately by you: DMV and county fees, USPS certified mail postage, the surety bond premium, the VIN inspection, and the vehicle appraisal.

Disclaimer: I provide administrative document formatting only. I do not provide legal advice, determine if a bonded title is your correct legal option, or issue surety bonds.

My Policies

Appointments

I work by appointment only. I confirm your total in writing before the appointment.

Payment

100% upfront: cash, Venmo, Zelle, bank transfer (ACH), or card (credit card payments have a 2% processing surcharge; debit cards have none). Notice required by Colorado: To cover the cost of processing a credit or charge card transaction, and pursuant to section 5-2-212, Colorado Revised Statutes, a seller or lessor may impose a processing surcharge in an amount not to exceed 2% of the total payment made for goods or services purchased or leased by use of a credit or charge card. A seller or lessor shall not impose a processing surcharge on payments made by use of cash, a check, or a debit card or redemption of a gift card.

Cancellations

Cancel or reschedule with 24+ hours’ notice and what you paid stays on your account as credit (it doesn’t expire). With less notice, or a no-show, I keep the deposit shown on your invoice (usually the mobile fee) and the rest is credit. If I cancel, you get a full refund.

Non-refundable mobile fee

If I arrive for a scheduled mobile appointment but the signing cannot proceed (for example, due to missing identification or absent signers), the Mobile & Convenience Fee is non-refundable because it covers my time and travel.

  • I am not an attorney and cannot provide legal advice.
  • I cannot select forms or tell you how to complete them.
  • I am not affiliated with the DMV, USCIS, or any government agency.
  • You are responsible for reviewing all documents before submission.
